questions.q: On an arm attempt the beeper gives a series of fast beeps (4 in 2025.12, 5 in 4.5), then 1 long and 3 short. Which Betaflight 2025.12 flag is it reporting?
options: ANGLE
THROTTLE
RUNAWAY
BOOTGRACE
questions.explain: Code = 5 × long + short = 8, which is bit 7 + 1. Bit 7 in armingDisableFlags_e is THROTTLE (throttle ≥ min_check 1050). ANGLE is code 9, RUNAWAY — 6, BOOTGRACE — 10. Codes 1–25 are the same in 4.5 and 2025.12.

questions.q: An aircraft with Betaflight 2025.12 does not arm, the ARM switch is on. What does the beeper report if RXLOSS, ANGLE and ARM_SWITCH are all set?
options: All three codes one after another
Only ARM_SWITCH, as the last flag
Only RXLOSS, the lowest bit
Only ANGLE, because RXLOSS is visible in the OSD
questions.explain: tryArm() calls beeperWarningBeeps(ffs(flags)): ffs returns the lowest set bit. The flags are ordered by criticality, and RXLOSS is bit 2 (code 3). The other reasons are visible in status and the OSD. In 4.5 the last flag was called ARMSWITCH, the logic is the same.

questions.q: A script got a flag count of 29 and the mask 0x10000080 from MSP_STATUS_EX. Which flags are set?
questions.fragment:
MSP_STATUS_EX: arming flag count = 29
armingDisableFlags = 0x10000080
4.5 table: bit 25 = ARMSWITCH (26 flags)
2025.12 table: bit 25 FLIP_SWITCH, 26 ALT_HOLD_SW, 27 POS_HOLD_SW, 28 ARM_SWITCH
options: THROTTLE and ARM_SWITCH (2025.12)
THROTTLE and an unknown bit — the mask is corrupt
ANGLE and ARMSWITCH (4.5)
THROTTLE and POS_HOLD_SW (2025.12)
questions.explain: 0x80 is bit 7 (THROTTLE), 0x10000000 is bit 28. With 29 flags this is 2025.12, where ARM_SWITCH moved to bit 28. The 4.5 table would give an “unknown bit”, which is why the table is chosen by the number of flags.

questions.q: Runaway takeoff prevention (the logic is the same in 4.5 and 2025.12) disarms the aircraft when…
options: |pidSum| on any axis ≥ 600 and the gyro is above 15 °/s (roll/pitch) or 50 °/s (yaw) continuously for longer than 75 ms
|pidSum| on any axis ≥ 500 (pidsum_limit) for longer than 500 ms after arming
the gyro on any axis is above 600 °/s for longer than 75 ms regardless of pidSum
the throttle is above 20 % with the sticks centered for longer than runaway_takeoff_deactivate_delay
questions.explain: fc/core.c: RUNAWAY_TAKEOFF_PIDSUM_THRESHOLD 600, GYRO_LIMIT_RP 15, GYRO_LIMIT_YAW 50, ACTIVATE_DELAY 75 ms. 500 is the mixer limit, the pidSum itself is not clipped. Throttle 20 % and 500 ms are the conditions for deactivating the protection, not for triggering it.

questions.q: A 5″ hovers at 26 % throttle (1300 µs with min_check 1050), sticks centered, runaway parameters at their defaults. Will the runaway protection be deactivated during this flight?
options: Yes, after 500 ms, because the throttle is above 20 %
Yes, after 250 ms, because the aircraft is in the air
No: without a stick deflection ≥ 15 % time accumulates only at throttle ≥ 40 %
No: the protection is deactivated only after a disarm and a repeat arm, and in the air it stays active
questions.explain: In processRx() “normal flight” is (throttle ≥ 20 % and a stick ≥ 15 %) or throttle ≥ 2 × 20 = 40 %, with |pidSum| < 100. At 26 % without sticks no time accumulates. 250 ms applies only at throttle ≥ 75 %.

questions.q: Actual rates, yaw_srate = 67 (670 °/s), yaw_spin_recovery = AUTO. At what yaw rate will the recovery turn on?
questions.explain: initYawSpinRecovery(): threshold = max_yaw + max(max_yaw/4, 200) = 670 + 200 = 870 °/s (limited to 500…1950). 1950 is the threshold only for ON with the default yaw_spin_threshold; 770 is the level below which the mode turns off (threshold − 100).

questions.q: A new build, the first liftoff: within a fraction of a second the aircraft flips over its right side and disarms, the beeper gives 1 long + 1 short. What do you check first?
options: Raise P and D on roll: on liftoff the aircraft lacks controller authority on this axis
Without props: the motor order, the rotation direction and the board orientation
Turn off runaway_takeoff_prevention, it is triggering falsely
Increase small_angle, the ANGLE flag is getting in the way of liftoff
questions.explain: 1 + 1 = code 6 = RUNAWAY: the controller has hit the limit and the aircraft keeps rotating. This is positive feedback — swapped motors, direction, props or align_board_*. PIDs will not help here, and disabling the protection removes the last safety net.

questions.q: Betaflight 2025.12 at defaults (feature AIRMODE enabled, `landing_disarm_threshold` = 0), a 5″ has landed on grass after a hover, the pilot holds the throttle at zero and does not disarm. What will happen?
options: After auto_disarm_delay = 5 s the FC disarms by itself
The motors will stop because the throttle is below min_check
Nothing: the PIDs turn off at throttle below airmode_start_throttle_percent, the motors go to idle and the aircraft stands quietly
The PIDs will keep holding level with the props in the ground, and the aircraft may bounce or flip over
questions.explain: Airmode latched when the throttle passed 25 %, and until disarm it keeps full PID authority at zero throttle. auto_disarm_delay works only with MOTOR_STOP without airmode and with stick arming. The fix is disarming right after touchdown; in 2025.12 `landing_disarm_threshold` can do this (off by default, 4.5 does not have it).
